ACTION 29 OF 32 · PHASE 08

Review the business every week

Make decisions from numbers and customer experience rather than activity.

WHEN TO DO THISAfter first real enquiries, bookings or deliveries.ESTIMATED WORK TIME30 min each week
↗
Your one job

Make decisions from numbers and customer experience rather than activity.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Record weekly enquiries by source, quotes, bookings, sales, costs, customer feedback and operational issues.

  2. 02

    Compare to the prior period; note what is actually known versus suspected causes.

  3. 03

    Choose three tasks with owner, due date and success check.

  4. 04

    Review open grants and partnership discussions without calling unverified opportunities 'open'.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Using only the weekly numbers I provide, create a concise operational brief: top-line metrics, what changed, known and unknown causes, customer issues, cash or capacity risks, opportunities checked with source dates and the next three accountable actions. Don't invent missing data. End with a clear continue/change/stop recommendation.
03

Finish with this

One-page weekly brief: what changed, why it matters and what you will do.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Metrics are real and dated
  • Actions have owners and success tests
  • Risks are not hidden by vanity metrics
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Confusing a busy week or likes with a profitable business.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A repeatable profitable process exists and the next investment is supported by measured results.
